nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) _balances holding token balances of every holder.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowances storing ERC20 spending approvals.
Private uint256 _tTotal, the fixed total supply 100 * 10**9 * 10**18 minted in the constructor.
Private address _owner in Ownable; written by the constructor, renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Private address newComer initialised to _msgSender() at deploy time; it, not _owner, is what the onlyOwner modifier compares against.
msg.sender, reached through Context._msgSender(); the only external caller-controlled input in this contract.
Low-level value call (bool success, ) = recipient.call{ value: amount }("") inside Address.sendValue, executed before any state reconciliation.
Low-level call (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call{ value: weiValue }(data) inside Address._functionCallWithValue, forwarding arbitrary calldata to a target address.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): validates addresses, debits sender and credits recipient in _balances, emits Transfer.
Public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) forwarding _msgSender() to _transfer.
Public transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): performs _transfer then decrements the allowance via _approve.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 amount) delegating to private _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
Private _approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount): zeroes the allowance when ol is not owner(), otherwise stores amount.
Public view balanceOf(address account) returning _balances[account].
Public view totalSupply() returning _tTotal.
Public view allowance(address owner, address spender) returning _allowances[owner][spender].
EINSTEININU constructor: mints the whole _tTotal to _msgSender() and emits Transfer.
Public onlyOwner renounceOwnership() setting _owner to address(0) and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Private onlyOwner transferOwnership(address newOwner) requiring a non-zero address and writing _owner.
Context._msgSender() view helper returning msg.sender.
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount): balance check followed by an unbounded low-level value transfer.
Address.functionCallWithValue(...) overloads routing into _functionCallWithValue, which executes a low-level call with value on the target.
Address.isContract(address account) using extcodehash to decide whether an address holds code.
Parameter sender of _transfer(address sender, ...).
Parameter recipient of _transfer(..., address recipient, ...).
Parameter amount of _transfer(..., uint256 amount).
Parameter spender of public approve(address spender, uint256 amount).
Parameter amount of public approve(address spender, uint256 amount).
Parameter recipient of public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount).
Parameter amount of public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount).
Parameter ol (owner) of private _approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount).
Parameter tt (spender) of private _approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount).
Parameter amount of private _approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount).
Parameter account of view balanceOf(address account).
Parameter owner of view allowance(address owner, address spender).
Parameter spender of view allowance(address owner, address spender).
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership(address newOwner), checked against the zero address before being written to _owner.
Parameter target of Address.functionCall/functionCallWithValue, the address receiving the low-level call.
Parameter data (bytes memory) forwarded verbatim as calldata to the external target.
Parameter value/weiValue attached to the low-level call.
Parameter recipient (address payable) that receives the low-level value transfer in sendValue.
Parameter amount transferred by sendValue and compared against address(this).balance.
Parameter account whose extcodehash is inspected by isContract.
Local variable msgSender in the Ownable constructor, assigned from _msgSender() and immediately stored into _owner.
Ownable constructor: reads _msgSender(), sets _owner and initialises the state variable newComer = _msgSender().

edges.reason: newComer is seeded from _msgSender() during construction, so the deployer permanently satisfies the onlyOwner check.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares newComer (a state variable frozen at deployment) against _msgSender().
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares newComer instead of the real _owner.
Caller-supplied msg.sender is the value compared against newComer before _owner is zeroed.
Caller-supplied msg.sender must equal newComer for transferOwnership to write _owner.
renounceOwnership irreversibly writes address(0) into the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable with newOwner.
_approve calls owner() and zeroes the allowance whenever the spender-owner argument differs from _owner.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender argument into _transfer.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the debit side of the balance update.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender when reducing the allowance.
approve uses _msgSender() as the owner argument of _approve.
The constructor mints the entire total supply to _msgSender().
Context._msgSender() simply returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
_msgSender() result is propagated into transfer.
_msgSender() result is propagated into transferFrom.
_msgSender() result is propagated into approve.
transfer delegates the balance mutation to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom first calls _transfer to move the tokens.
transferFrom then calls _approve to reduce the remaining allowance.
approve delegates all allowance logic to the private _approve.
_approve is the only writer of the _allowances state variable.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][msg.sender] to subtract the spent amount.
allowance returns the _allowances entry for owner and spender.
balanceOf reads the _balances state variable.
totalSupply returns the immutable _tTotal state variable.
The constructor initialises _balances for the deployer.
_transfer debits sender and credits recipient in _balances.
sendValue reaches the unbounded low-level call to recipient, which can re-enter before the caller finishes bookkeeping.
_functionCallWithValue executes a low-level call with value to an arbitrary target, enabling re-entrant callbacks.
Parameter sender selects the _balances entry debited by _transfer.
Parameter recipient selects the _balances entry credited by _transfer.
Parameter amount is subtracted from sender and added to recipient.
Parameter spender becomes the tt argument of _approve.
Parameter amount becomes the allowance value written by _approve.
Parameter recipient is forwarded from transfer to _transfer.
Parameter amount is forwarded from transfer to _transfer.
Parameter ol indexes the _allowances mapping and is compared against owner().
Parameter tt is the spender index written in _allowances.
Parameter amount is the allowance value stored by _approve.
Parameter account indexes the _balances mapping returned by balanceOf.
Parameter owner is the first key of the _allowances lookup.
Parameter spender is the second key of the _allowances lookup.
Parameter newOwner is validated and then written into the _owner state variable.
Parameter target receives the low-level call inside _functionCallWithValue.
Parameter data is passed verbatim as low-level calldata to the target.
Parameter value/weiValue is attached to the low-level call.
Parameter recipient is the destination of the low-level value transfer in sendValue.
Parameter amount is checked against address(this).balance and then sent.
Parameter account is hashed with extcodehash by isContract.
Local msgSender from _msgSender() is stored into the _owner state variable.
The same local deployer address is written into newComer, the value the onlyOwner modifier trusts.
The Ownable constructor is the only place where _owner is initialised.
The Ownable constructor creates the local variable msgSender from _msgSender().
